scope: Every original FlexRay parameter independently reviewed. Native rates/version separation, word-based payload/header/segment, global cycle/slot and local clock/startup/channel/buffer parameters declared and typed. Version-specific schema_when prevents applying represented3.0.1 limits to NXP2.1 or DEVICE_SPECIFIC; unsupported variant fields stay UNVERIFIED after type checking.
